description.value: AC Gas is the retail gas station and convenience store of locally owned AC Petroleum, situated in downtown Pemberton on Prospect Street. It stocks convenience store items alongside gasoline, diesel, oils, and propane cylinder exchanges — making it a practical multi-stop for touring cyclists passing through the Sea-to-Sky corridor. Compressed air is available on site, and the broader AC Petroleum network also operates 24/7 cardlock stations in Pemberton and Whistler.

The /locations page corroborates the OSM phone number (604) 894-1701 and address. The website explicitly lists propane cylinder exchange at this location, and OSM's compressed_air=yes tag indicates an air pump; convenience store items are confirmed by website language 'a variety of convenience store items.'
concerns: The website URL belongs to the parent company AC Petroleum (acpetroleum.com), not a dedicated AC Gas page; no standalone website exists for this location. Head office address (7338 Industrial Way) differs from AC Gas address (7432 Prospect Street) — these are two distinct AC Petroleum locations and should not be confused.
